attributes.why_unmapped: BREACH_STANDARD: The breach termination right requires the breach to be material enough to cause the failure of the closing condition in Section 8.2(a) (breach by the Company) or Section 8.3(a) (breach by Parent).

open_world.raw_value: at any time prior to receipt of the Company Stockholder Approval

attributes.why_unmapped: PRE_VOTE_LIMIT: The Company's superior-proposal termination right is exercisable only before the Company Stockholder Approval is obtained.

open_world.raw_value: This Agreement may be terminated and the Mergers may be abandoned at any time prior to the Effective Time (notwithstanding the obtaining of the Company Stockholder Approval)

attributes.why_unmapped: A general chapeau stating termination rights remain available even after the Company Stockholder Approval is obtained; resembles a PRE_VOTE_LIMIT but states the opposite of a limit and frames every clause rather than one right.

open_world.raw_value: provided, however, that the right to terminate this Agreement under this Section 9.1(b)(i) shall not be available to any party whose failure to fulfill any obligation under this Agreement has principally caused or resulted in the failure of the Effective Time to occur on or before the End Date or the Extended End Date, as applicable

attributes.why_unmapped: A carve-out disqualifying a party whose own failure caused the delay from exercising the End Date termination right; not itself a right grant, deadline, or cure period.

open_world.raw_value: provided, that the right to terminate this Agreement under this Section 9.1(c) shall not be available to any party whose failure to fulfill any obligation under Section 7.1 has principally caused or resulted in the imposition of such legal restraint or the failure of such legal restraint to be resisted, resolved or lifted

attributes.why_unmapped: A carve-out disqualifying a party whose own failure caused or failed to resolve the legal restraint from exercising the legal-restraint termination right; not itself a right grant, deadline, or cure period.

open_world.raw_value: the Company has received a Superior Proposal after the date of this Agreement that did not result from a breach of Section 5.2 or Section 5.3, (ii) the Company has complied with Section 5.3(b)(i) with respect to such Superior Proposal, (iii) concurrently with, and as a condition to, any such termination the Company pays or causes to be paid to Parent (or its designee) the Termination Fee pursuant to Section 10.5 and (iv) the Board of Directors of the Company has authorized the Company to enter into, and the Company concurrently enters into, a definitive written agreement providing for such Superior Proposal

attributes.why_unmapped: A set of conditions precedent to exercising the Company's superior-proposal termination right (no-breach sourcing of the proposal, compliance with the matching procedure, concurrent termination-fee payment, and board authorization); not itself a right grant, deadline, cure period, or one of the wave-B evidence surfaces.

open_world.raw_value: The party desiring to terminate this Agreement pursuant to clause (b), (c), (d), (e) or (f) of this Section 9.1 shall give written notice of such termination to the other party in accordance with Section 10.1, specifying the provision hereof pursuant to which such termination is effected.

attributes.why_unmapped: A general procedural requirement to give written notice specifying the operative termination clause; no day count is stated, so it does not fit the CURE_PERIOD (NOTICE) shape.
attributes.nearest_concept: CURE_PERIOD (NOTICE) -- but no day count is stated

open_world.raw_value: the agreements contained in this Section 9.2, in Section 10.4, Section 10.5 and Section 10.6, and in the Confidentiality Agreement shall survive the termination hereof

attributes.why_unmapped: States which provisions survive termination (a general survival clause naming cross-referenced sections), not a termination right, outside date, cure period, or any Wave B surface

open_world.raw_value: no such termination shall relieve any party of any liability or damages resulting from any material and intentional breach by that party of this Agreement

attributes.why_unmapped: States a post-termination liability carve-out keyed to a 'material and intentional' breach standard, but this qualifies surviving liability after termination rather than the breach standard governing a termination right or closing condition
